mapper.select: SELECT RAWTOHEX(id) AS id, username, display_name AS displayName, password_hash AS passwordHash, account_status AS accountStatus, auth_source AS authSource FROM edudoc_user WHERE username = #{username}
SELECT account_status FROM edudoc_user WHERE id = HEXTORAW(#{userIdHex})

SELECT r.role_code FROM edudoc_role r JOIN edudoc_user_role ur ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = HEXTORAW(#{userIdHex}) AND r.status = 'A' AND (ur.effective_to IS NULL OR ur.effective_to > SYSTIMESTAMP)

SELECT DISTINCT p.permission_code FROM edudoc_permission p JOIN edudoc_role_permission rp ON p.id = rp.permission_id JOIN edudoc_user_role ur ON rp.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = HEXTORAW(#{userIdHex}) AND (ur.effective_to IS NULL OR ur.effective_to > SYSTIMESTAMP)
